Proposed diagram changes
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Modify (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext
      |   |-- Replace the single uploaded-history, whole-diagram edit path with saved-context resolution, pinned references, scoped editing, creation, extension and variant generation.
      |   |-- Introduce AgentContextLibrary as the saved-context owner: saved-context callers create, list and read through it; AgentContextService resolves saved IDs through it. It owns repository coordination and delegates source capture, pins and blob I/O to the source adapter.
      |   |-- Show diagram-context compilation from captured evidence, stored associations and fingerprint-checked fallback during generation; keep canvas publication separate from revision issuance.
      |   `-- Treat API entry points, MappingPage UI and persistence parents as read-only relationships.
      |-- [1a] Modify [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
      |   `-- Add saved or supplied context, panel session identity, pinned diagram/node references, templates, source-mapping choice, whole/subtree replacement modes, and create/extend/variant options with their distinct preconditions.
      |-- [1a] Modify [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
      |   |-- Capture immutable input and context hashes for retry identity; resolve pinned revisions and diagram-associated context before generation.
      |   `-- Distinguish generated revisions, retained variants, placement of new diagrams, application acknowledgement and context publication after success.
      |-- [1b] Extend [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
      |   |-- Add version-2 source-range descriptors with Git commits or snapshot hashes, portable evidence attachments, lazy source resolution and a separately hashed resolved context.
      |   `-- Keep trajectory parsing, validation and Pi-message conversion in AgentContext; historical tool calls remain context, not replayed actions.
      |-- [1a] Modify [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
      |   `-- Replace in-memory Pi sessions with persistent session managers; seed them with resolved, copied context while keeping the current model, prompt and tools independent of historical provenance.
      |-- [1a] Modify [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
      |   `-- Separate validated revision issuance, explicit runtime retention and canvas publication; show retained review variants and diagram-context associations without treating generation as an implicit canvas edit.
      `-- [2] Add: Saved AgentContexts and pinned source evidence (N3)
          |-- Attach from the AgentContextLibrary component introduced in (O), with a connection to its detailed representation.
          `-- Detail saved records and repository, Git/blob source adapter, lazy reads, portable evidence, and diagram association using agentContextLibrary.ts, savedAgentContext.ts, agentContextSource.ts, agentContext.ts, diagramAgentContext.ts, fileAgentContextRepository.ts, fileAgentContextSources.ts and fileDiagramAgentContextStore.ts. Preserve the unrelated [New diagram] placeholder.
